title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Kaliforms Kali…
description: Kali Forms versions up to 2.4.31 are affected by a reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This vulnerability allows an attacker to inject malicious scripts that can execute in the context of a user's browser. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.1. No patch or remediation information is currently available.
